messages:
taylor_sales: FYI — Prospect HealthBridge just sent a HIPAA questionnaire. They want answers about audit logs, retention (7y), per-tenant export, and data residency. Attaching redacted snippet.
nina_support: Uploaded redacted PDF to shared drive: https://drive.redwood/healthbridge/qna.pdf
maya_pm: Thanks. Can we triage quickly? This looks like onboarding-blocker level. Quick Qs: (1) event-level vs aggregated logs? (2) any EU residency constraints called out?
taylor_sales: They explicitly say 'event-level' for admin/access logs, 7 years. Also asking that logs for EU users stay in EU regions.
sam_security: 7y event-level is heavy. Need to confirm exact log types: auth events, admin actions, model input retention? Note: we can't promise raw model inputs without a signed BAA.
liam_eng: Engineering view: feasible via append-only audit stream -> per-tenant bucket + lifecycle to Glacier. Need index metadata in DB for fast retrieval. Rough effort: 3 sprints (6-8 weeks) to do per-tenant config + export API + KMS integration.
maya_pm: Proposed next steps:
1) Create spec ticket: "per-tenant event audit + retention + export"
2) Draft acceptance criteria and launch blockers
3) Security review + legal BAA check
4) Rough estimate and prioritization
nina_support: Customer timeline: needs formal answer by EOW next week. Sales wants a firm onboarding scope.
sam_security: I'll draft a short risk memo: what we can promise in 30 days vs what goes on long-term roadmap. We should avoid promising raw transcript retention before BAA.
taylor_sales: If we can commit to config + encrypted export + 1y retention in 30 days, they'll sign. Anything promised must be testable.
maya_pm: Draft acceptance criteria (will add to ticket):
- Configurable retention per-tenant (min 1y, up to 7y)
- Audit log export API (NDJSON) with time-range and signature verification
- Logs encrypted at rest; option for customer-managed KMS
- Retrieval SLO: search + export under 5s for a 24h window; larger ranges async
- Docs + runbook for legal/audit requests
liam_eng: Retrieval SLO depends on indexing approach. 5s for 24h window reasonable; multi-year exports will be async jobs with notification.
maya_pm: Priority suggestion: P1 for HealthBridge onboarding (sales-driven), product-default P2. Need eng lead + security OK. @sam_security please approve risk memo; @liam_eng please confirm estimate and schedule a spike.
sam_security: OK to proceed with risk memo. We'll require signed BAA before enabling raw input retention for models. If customer accepts anonymized logs only, lower risk.
deploy-bot: Created ticket PROD-2389: "Per-tenant event audit + retention + export (HealthBridge onboarding)" Assigned: maya_pm, liam_eng. https://board.redwood/PROD-2389 :thumbsup:
taylor_sales: Thanks. I'll tell them initial scope: config + encrypted export + default 1y retention within 3 weeks; full 7y retention on roadmap.
maya_pm: I'll add acceptance criteria to PROD-2389 and ping Legal for BAA. Adding checklist to onboarding guide. Note: we will not store model inputs long-term unless BAA signed. :lock:
nina_support: Noted — attaching customer's exact questionnaire to the ticket now.
sam_security: I'll post the risk memo in this thread tomorrow. If Legal requests changes we will update scope.
liam_eng: Starting tech spike Monday. Will post notes and a tiny prototype for append-only buckets + index schema.
taylor_sales: Great — thanks all. :rocket:
